### Framework adapters

Everything framework-specific. One package per framework; see docs/frameworks.md.

### Compiler

Turns an agent folder into a compiled artifact: discovery, composition, lowering, artifact loader.

- [`_library.py`](../../src/harnest/_library.py): Process-scoped namespaces for authored reusable Python modules.
- [`agent_tree.py`](../../src/harnest/agent_tree.py): Walk a managed agent tree: definitions, graphs, subagents, and native agents.

- [`bundle.py`](../../src/harnest/bundle.py): The compiler: turns an agent folder into a framework-native application.

- [`source_tree.py`](../../src/harnest/source_tree.py): Shared policy for authored files excluded from compiled source artifacts.

## Go: the `harnest` CLI, engine, and internal packages

### cmd/harnest/

- [`add.go`](../../cmd/harnest/add.go): `harnest add`: the parent command, `add mcp`, and the shared scaffolds behind each `harnest add <kind> NAME`.
- [`add_cron.go`](../../cmd/harnest/add_cron.go): `harnest add cron NAME`: scaffolds a scheduled task in the agent's cron/ folder.
- [`add_eval.go`](../../cmd/harnest/add_eval.go): `harnest add eval NAME`: chooses an eval scaffold, by flag or prompt, and writes it.
- [`add_eval_files.go`](../../cmd/harnest/add_eval_files.go): Writes the files behind `harnest add eval`: eval sets, custom criteria, and test_config.json updates.
- [`agent_plugins.go`](../../cmd/harnest/agent_plugins.go): `harnest plugins`: installs standard Agent Plugins into an agent and validates their manifests.
- [`artifact_cache.go`](../../cmd/harnest/artifact_cache.go): Compiled-artifact cache for `harnest serve`; a cached generation is reused only when complete and validated.
- [`channels.go`](../../cmd/harnest/channels.go): `harnest add channel` and `harnest channels`: connect messaging platforms through a channel extension.
- [`commands.go`](../../cmd/harnest/commands.go): `harnest compile`, `harnest test`, and `harnest serve`: the commands that hand an agent to the Python compiler and runtime.
- [`compile_executable.go`](../../cmd/harnest/compile_executable.go): `harnest compile --format executable`: packs a compiled agent and its runtime into one native executable.
- [`compile_selection.go`](../../cmd/harnest/compile_selection.go): Reads an agent's compile selection (extras and requirements to bundle) without running pack code.
- [`dependency_policy.go`](../../cmd/harnest/dependency_policy.go): Rejects agent requirements that pin packages the Harnest compiler owns, such as Harnest itself and framework SDKs.
- [`doctor.go`](../../cmd/harnest/doctor.go): `harnest doctor`: checks Python, the agent's managed environment, and the framework packages it needs.
- [`environment.go`](../../cmd/harnest/environment.go): `harnest env` and the managed per-agent Python environments that every command runs in.
- [`environment_framework.go`](../../cmd/harnest/environment_framework.go): Records the agent's framework version in harnest.lock and checks that the installed version matches.
- [`environment_profile.go`](../../cmd/harnest/environment_profile.go): Environment profiles (compile, test, serve, ...): the wheel extras and lock file each one uses.
- [`environment_prune.go`](../../cmd/harnest/environment_prune.go): Leases that keep a managed environment alive while a command uses it, and pruning of stale environments.
- [`environment_runtime_lock.go`](../../cmd/harnest/environment_runtime_lock.go): Resolves and validates the hashed requirements lock for an agent's runtime environment.
- [`environment_slots.go`](../../cmd/harnest/environment_slots.go): Reusable environment slots: replacing an environment safely and migrating legacy layouts.
- [`environment_vscode.go`](../../cmd/harnest/environment_vscode.go): Points VS Code's Python interpreter setting at the agent's managed environment.
- [`eval_progress.go`](../../cmd/harnest/eval_progress.go): Terminal progress display for `harnest test --evals`.
- [`extension_format.go`](../../cmd/harnest/extension_format.go): Naming rules for Harnest Extension distributions: the canonical package prefix and wheel format.
- [`extension_pypi.go`](../../cmd/harnest/extension_pypi.go): Downloads and stages Harnest Extensions published on PyPI.
- [`extension_verify.go`](../../cmd/harnest/extension_verify.go): Verifies a PyPI extension before installing it: release files, wheel names, hashes, and entry points.
- [`extensions.go`](../../cmd/harnest/extensions.go): `harnest extensions`: searches the PyPI extension catalog and lists installed extensions.
- [`extensions_local.go`](../../cmd/harnest/extensions_local.go): `harnest extensions init|install`: creates a local extension project and installs extensions into an agent.
- [`framework_compatibility.go`](../../cmd/harnest/framework_compatibility.go): Framework package requirements, derived from the shared metadata in internal/frameworks.
- [`framework_scaffolds.go`](../../cmd/harnest/framework_scaffolds.go): Starter files that differ by agent framework. Adding a framework adds one frameworkScaffolds entry here.
- [`init.go`](../../cmd/harnest/init.go): `harnest init`: creates a new agent from a scaffold profile, a template, or a pack.
- [`init_examples.go`](../../cmd/harnest/init_examples.go): Example files `harnest init` writes into a managed agent's optional folders.
- [`init_guides.go`](../../cmd/harnest/init_guides.go): README guides `harnest init` writes into each optional agent folder.
- [`local_package.go`](../../cmd/harnest/local_package.go): Copies a local package tree (plugin or extension) into an agent safely: no links, no paths outside the tree.
- [`main.go`](../../cmd/harnest/main.go): Entry point of the `harnest` CLI.
- [`mcp.go`](../../cmd/harnest/mcp.go): `harnest mcp`: forwards MCP operations to the Python runtime.
- [`mode.go`](../../cmd/harnest/mode.go): `harnest mode advanced --check`: reports what moving an agent from managed to advanced mode would change.
- [`pack_commands.go`](../../cmd/harnest/pack_commands.go): `harnest pack validate|build|run|types`: pack commands that run pack code in Python.
- [`playground.go`](../../cmd/harnest/playground.go): Stages the embedded development playground UI used by `harnest serve`.
- [`project_pack_init.go`](../../cmd/harnest/project_pack_init.go): `harnest pack` and `harnest pack init NAME`: scaffolds a new Harnest pack (pack.yaml and pack.py).
- [`provision.go`](../../cmd/harnest/provision.go): `harnest provision`: forwards provisioning to the Python provisioner.
- [`python.go`](../../cmd/harnest/python.go): Chooses the Python interpreter for a command and loads the agent bundle it runs against.
- [`reload.go`](../../cmd/harnest/reload.go): Hot reload for `harnest serve`: rebuilds an artifact generation when files change and swaps the server.
- [`reload_compiler.go`](../../cmd/harnest/reload_compiler.go): Long-lived Python compiler process (harnest.compiler_daemon) that hot reload uses for fast recompiles.
- [`root.go`](../../cmd/harnest/root.go): Builds the root `harnest` command, registers every subcommand, and holds shared process settings.
- [`run.go`](../../cmd/harnest/run.go): `harnest run`: sends one message to an agent and prints the reply.
- [`runtime.go`](../../cmd/harnest/runtime.go): `harnest runtime`: installs the CLI's Python runtime; parent of `harnest runtime build`.
- [`runtime_dependency_plan.go`](../../cmd/harnest/runtime_dependency_plan.go): Works out the runtime packages an agent needs from its agents, MCP clients, extensions, and packages.
- [`runtime_pack.go`](../../cmd/harnest/runtime_pack.go): `harnest runtime build`: builds a shared, relocatable Python runtime pack for agent executables.
- [`runtime_pack_lock.go`](../../cmd/harnest/runtime_pack_lock.go): Lock constraints that decide which agents may share a runtime pack.
- [`runtime_pack_plan.go`](../../cmd/harnest/runtime_pack_plan.go): Merges several agents' requirements into one shared runtime pack plan.
- [`runtime_pack_report.go`](../../cmd/harnest/runtime_pack_report.go): Build report for a runtime pack: which distributions were installed, and why.
- [`runtime_pack_tools.go`](../../cmd/harnest/runtime_pack_tools.go): Makes console scripts in a runtime pack relocatable, including Windows launchers.
- [`skills.go`](../../cmd/harnest/skills.go): `harnest skills`: shows or installs the embedded Harnest guidance for coding agents.
- [`studio_environment.go`](../../cmd/harnest/studio_environment.go): Installs and reuses Studio's own Python environment, kept separate from every agent's.
- [`studio_launcher.go`](../../cmd/harnest/studio_launcher.go): `harnest studio`: starts Harnest Studio against a workspace, optionally with a pack.
- [`template.go`](../../cmd/harnest/template.go): Agent templates published as wheels: resolves, downloads, and scaffolds an agent from one.
- [`template_package.go`](../../cmd/harnest/template_package.go): `harnest template package`: packages an agent directory as a reusable template wheel.
- [`template_services.go`](../../cmd/harnest/template_services.go): Validates the services (compose-style containers) that a template declares.
- [`upgrade.go`](../../cmd/harnest/upgrade.go): `harnest upgrade`: migrates an agent to the current Harnest layout and runs pack upgrades.

### cmd/harnest-agent/

- [`main.go`](../../cmd/harnest-agent/main.go): harnest-agent is the dependency-free native launcher embedded in agent executables.
- [`process_unix.go`](../../cmd/harnest-agent/process_unix.go): Waits for the agent process on macOS and Linux.
- [`process_windows.go`](../../cmd/harnest-agent/process_windows.go): Runs the agent inside a Windows job object so it stops when the launcher stops.

### cmd/hostlier-harnest/

- [`artifact.go`](../../cmd/hostlier-harnest/artifact.go): Command hostlier-harnest packages a Harnest agent for an ordinary Hostlier container workload.
- [`base_image.go`](../../cmd/hostlier-harnest/base_image.go): Resolves the pinned Harnest base image for a Hostlier workload.
- [`hooks.go`](../../cmd/hostlier-harnest/hooks.go): Validates project inputs and prepares the reviewed Hostlier build context.
- [`init.go`](../../cmd/hostlier-harnest/init.go): Proposes starter agent files and their Hostlier workload settings.
- [`main.go`](../../cmd/hostlier-harnest/main.go): Dispatches Hostlier package discovery, initialization, and build hooks.
- [`project.go`](../../cmd/hostlier-harnest/project.go): Reads and validates packages.harnest settings from the Hostlier project.

### engine/

- [`compile.go`](../../engine/compile.go): Runs the Python compiler for a bundle, then loads the compiled artifact and checks its manifest.
- [`deploy.go`](../../engine/deploy.go): Compiles and deploys many bundles concurrently and records each result.
- [`digest.go`](../../engine/digest.go): Content digest of an agent bundle, used to detect source changes.
- [`discover.go`](../../engine/discover.go): Finds agent directories in a project and loads their bundles.
- [`evaluation.go`](../../engine/evaluation.go): Agent evaluation settings (spec.evaluation) and their validation.
- [`load.go`](../../engine/load.go): Loads and validates an agent bundle's config.yaml and deployment plans.
- [`types.go`](../../engine/types.go): Package engine implements the Go-side runtime contract for Harnest agents.

### internal/agentlauncher/

- [`asset_darwin_amd64.go`](../../internal/agentlauncher/asset_darwin_amd64.go): Embeds the prebuilt agent launcher for macOS amd64 release builds.
- [`asset_darwin_arm64.go`](../../internal/agentlauncher/asset_darwin_arm64.go): Embeds the prebuilt agent launcher for macOS arm64 release builds.
- [`asset_linux_amd64.go`](../../internal/agentlauncher/asset_linux_amd64.go): Embeds the prebuilt agent launcher for Linux amd64 release builds.
- [`asset_linux_arm64.go`](../../internal/agentlauncher/asset_linux_arm64.go): Embeds the prebuilt agent launcher for Linux arm64 release builds.
- [`asset_windows_amd64.go`](../../internal/agentlauncher/asset_windows_amd64.go): Embeds the prebuilt agent launcher for Windows amd64 release builds.
- [`asset_windows_arm64.go`](../../internal/agentlauncher/asset_windows_arm64.go): Embeds the prebuilt agent launcher for Windows arm64 release builds.
- [`development.go`](../../internal/agentlauncher/development.go): Builds the launcher from source for contributor (non-release) builds.
- [`launcher.go`](../../internal/agentlauncher/launcher.go): Package agentlauncher supplies a small native bootstrap without the CLI's build assets.
- [`release.go`](../../internal/agentlauncher/release.go): Returns the prebuilt, embedded launcher in release builds.

### internal/agentpack/

- [`console.go`](../../internal/agentpack/console.go): Command line that starts an agent from an unpacked executable.
- [`executable.go`](../../internal/agentpack/executable.go): Writes an agent executable: the native launcher with the runtime and agent appended as a zip payload.
- [`macho.go`](../../internal/agentpack/macho.go): Keeps macOS (Mach-O) executables valid after the payload is appended.
- [`manifest.go`](../../internal/agentpack/manifest.go): Package agentpack stores immutable portable runtimes and agent payloads.
- [`materialize.go`](../../internal/agentpack/materialize.go): Unpacks an executable's runtime and agent into the content-addressed cache and verifies them.
- [`objects.go`](../../internal/agentpack/objects.go): Content-addressed object store for runtime and agent files.
- [`platform.go`](../../internal/agentpack/platform.go): File permission and Windows path safety rules for packed files.
- [`python.go`](../../internal/agentpack/python.go): Python command and environment for running an unpacked agent.

### internal/agentscaffold/

- [`managed.go`](../../internal/agentscaffold/managed.go): Package agentscaffold provides the shared minimal managed agent used by Harnest initializers.

### internal/devtools/orchestrator/

- [`main.go`](../../internal/devtools/orchestrator/main.go): Command orchestrator exercises the compile/deploy engine for repository development. It is invoked by make dry-run and is not part of the released CLI surface.

### internal/features/

- [`deployment.go`](../../internal/features/deployment.go): Package features owns process-level opt-ins for unreleased functionality.

### internal/frameworks/

- [`frameworks.go`](../../internal/frameworks/frameworks.go): Package frameworks exposes the release-owned agent framework metadata shared with the Python compiler.

### internal/runtimewheel/

- [`wheel.go`](../../internal/runtimewheel/wheel.go): Package runtimewheel owns the Python wheel embedded in release CLI binaries.

### internal/uvbootstrap/

- [`asset_darwin_amd64.go`](../../internal/uvbootstrap/asset_darwin_amd64.go): Embeds a placeholder in place of uv for development builds on macOS amd64.
- [`asset_darwin_arm64.go`](../../internal/uvbootstrap/asset_darwin_arm64.go): Embeds a placeholder in place of uv for development builds on macOS arm64.
- [`asset_linux_amd64.go`](../../internal/uvbootstrap/asset_linux_amd64.go): Embeds a placeholder in place of uv for development builds on Linux amd64.
- [`asset_linux_arm64.go`](../../internal/uvbootstrap/asset_linux_arm64.go): Embeds a placeholder in place of uv for development builds on Linux arm64.
- [`asset_release_darwin_amd64.go`](../../internal/uvbootstrap/asset_release_darwin_amd64.go): Embeds the uv binary for release builds on macOS amd64.
- [`asset_release_darwin_arm64.go`](../../internal/uvbootstrap/asset_release_darwin_arm64.go): Embeds the uv binary for release builds on macOS arm64.
- [`asset_release_linux_amd64.go`](../../internal/uvbootstrap/asset_release_linux_amd64.go): Embeds the uv binary for release builds on Linux amd64.
- [`asset_release_linux_arm64.go`](../../internal/uvbootstrap/asset_release_linux_arm64.go): Embeds the uv binary for release builds on Linux arm64.
- [`asset_release_windows_amd64.go`](../../internal/uvbootstrap/asset_release_windows_amd64.go): Embeds the uv binary for release builds on Windows amd64.
- [`asset_release_windows_arm64.go`](../../internal/uvbootstrap/asset_release_windows_arm64.go): Embeds the uv binary for release builds on Windows arm64.
- [`asset_windows_amd64.go`](../../internal/uvbootstrap/asset_windows_amd64.go): Embeds a placeholder in place of uv for development builds on Windows amd64.
- [`asset_windows_arm64.go`](../../internal/uvbootstrap/asset_windows_arm64.go): Embeds a placeholder in place of uv for development builds on Windows arm64.
- [`bootstrap.go`](../../internal/uvbootstrap/bootstrap.go): Package uvbootstrap owns the native uv executable embedded in release CLIs.

### schemas/

- [`schemas.go`](../../schemas/schemas.go): Package schemas gives Go code the same published JSON schemas users validate their files against, so the CLI and engine never keep their own copies.

### src/harnest/_playground/

- [`_playground/assets.go`](../../src/harnest/_playground/assets.go): Package playground embeds development UI assets in the native CLI, not the Python wheel.
